groups.title: 課本 · U1
groups.subtitle: Firsts in Life
groups.summary: Robbie 分享第一次線上課、Claire 回想第一次報告失敗、Nancy 描述第一次出國到首爾。三則經驗分別有好笑、尷尬和難忘的時刻；文章提醒人們從經驗中學習。
grammar: 過去簡單式敘述已發生的第一次經驗：took, yelled, skipped, ruined, realized。
副詞修飾動詞：accidentally turned on；fortunately, everyone was friendly。
remind + 人 + to V；make sure + (that) 子句。
upset 作動詞時可直接接受詞；作形容詞時用 be upset about + N / V-ing。
現在分詞 embarrassed / depressed 描述人的感受；embarrassing / depressing 描述令人產生該感受的事物。
片語：the rest (of)、in person、take ... seriously、let ... down、put ... first、dress up。

groups.title: Core 3 · U1
groups.subtitle: 團結、決心與生活
groups.summary: 以動詞、形容詞和衍生字為主。特別看 remain 的補語、determine 的 to V，以及 jealous / envious 的介系詞。
grammar: remain + N / adj. / p.p.：維持某狀態；不是 remain + adv.
determine to V = make up one’s mind to V；be determined to V。
be jealous of / be envious of；frighten sb into V-ing。
besides + N / V-ing 是介系詞；Besides, ... 是副詞。
lately / recently 常配現在完成式；將來的「近期」用 in the near future。

groups.title: Core 3 · U2
groups.subtitle: 許可、回應與成就
groups.summary: 掌握 permit / allow、prevent ... from、response / responsibility，以及各種 -ful 形容詞。
grammar: permit / allow sb to V；permit / allow V-ing。
prevent sb / sth from V-ing；avoid + V-ing。
respond to；in response to；take responsibility for = be responsible for。
vary vi. 變化；various adj. 各式各樣；a variety of + 複數名詞。
downtown 作副詞時，go downtown 不加 to。

groups.title: Core 3 · U3
groups.subtitle: 反應、生活與特性
groups.summary: 從集合名詞、讓步片語到形容詞搭配。audience / staff / crew 的用法和 anxious 的介系詞值得特別複習。
grammar: a large / small audience：用 large / small 表人數多寡。
a staff / crew of + 人數；數個員工用 staff members。
in spite of / despite + N / V-ing；不是 in spite of + 完整句。
an additional + 數字 = an extra + 數字。
take advantage of sth 利用；take advantage of sb 占便宜。
be anxious about 擔心；be anxious to V 渴望。

groups.title: 課本 · U2
groups.subtitle: Goodbye, John
groups.summary: Sally 寫信與「John」告別。略讀時找開頭與結尾、各段主題句，再整理手機對學業、朋友和家人的影響。
grammar: have / has + p.p.：完成、經驗、由過去延續到現在。
for + 一段時間；since + 時間起點／過去式子句。
V-ing 可當主詞：Leaving you really breaks my heart.
be busy V-ing；stop V-ing 停止做；stop to V 停下來去做。
原因訊號 because / since / for / as；結果訊號 so / thus / therefore。
書信：Dear ... → 內文 → Best wishes / Best regards / Sincerely yours → 姓名。

groups.title: 課本 · U3
groups.subtitle: Do Animals Sleep like You and Me?
groups.summary: 掌握動物睡眠相關單字，以及間接問句的正常語序。保留原頁中的練習；手寫作答若有錯，不當成標準答案。
grammar: 間接問句：疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞；不倒裝。
Where is Jason? → Do you know where Jason is?
What did Jim do? → I don’t know what Jim did.
若 who 本身是主詞：I’m wondering who sent me these flowers.
avoid + V-ing；have trouble + V-ing。
a wide variety of；vary in；various + 複數名詞。

groups.title: 9月雜誌 · U1
groups.subtitle: Opera and Musicals
groups.summary: 歌劇源於約四百年前的義大利，以古典歌唱和音樂為主；音樂劇起於十九世紀，結合說話、歌唱和舞蹈。共同目的：用音樂與表演說故事。
grammar: 被動語態：S + be + p.p.（+ by + O）。
set A apart from B；look into；take place。
both A and B；allow sb to V。
for example / for instance 接舉例句；such as + 名詞列舉。
still 在課文結尾意為「儘管如此」。

groups.title: 9月雜誌 · U2
groups.subtitle: Taiwan’s Scooter Culture
groups.summary: 從機車的便利與價格優勢，略讀臺灣機車文化的歷史與未來。新科技與環保議題持續影響其發展。
grammar: 比較級前可加 far / much / a lot / even / a little / a bit / slightly。
very 修飾原級，不直接修飾比較級。
as 可表示「當…時」「因為」「正如」「以…身分」；as ... as 同級比較。
depend on；range from A to B；take shape。

groups.title: 9月雜誌 · U5
groups.subtitle: Germany’s Dual Education System
groups.summary: 雙軌制結合學校理論與公司實作。學生在畢業前累積工作經驗，免付學費並可領月薪，亦有進一步升學機會。
grammar: 分數：分子用基數、分母用序數；分子 > 1，分母通常加 s。
two-thirds of students are ...；人口、面積等作整体看語意決定動詞。
depending on；range from A to B；keep sth going。
what’s more / on top of that / plus / in addition 表補充。

groups.title: 9月雜誌 · U6
groups.subtitle: Meet Agatha Christie
groups.summary: 第一天介紹克莉絲蒂的作品與偵探角色；第二天說明她一九二六年失蹤十一天的事件與各種推測。
grammar: 同位語：名詞, 補充說明名詞, ...；相當於省略 which / who is 的補充。
過去完成式：had + p.p.，表示比另一過去事件更早發生。
be known for N / V-ing；suspect sb of N / V-ing。
go missing；check in at；on purpose。

groups.title: 9月雜誌 · U8
groups.subtitle: The Melamine Sponge
groups.summary: 科技海綿以細小而堅硬的結構去除污垢，但不適用於所有表面，也可能留下刮痕、碎屑。使用前測試小區域，清潔後再沖洗。
grammar: have trouble / difficulty / problems / a hard time + (in) V-ing。
trouble / difficulty 通常不可數；problem 可數。
because + S + V；because of + N / V-ing。
even though + S + V；without + V-ing。
suitable for；fall apart；keep in mind；give off。

groups.title: 9月雜誌 · U11
groups.subtitle: Should Some Places Say “No Kids”?
groups.summary: 支持者重視安靜與舒適，反對者強調兒童的社會參與和學習機會。結論主張家長與其他成人共同努力、互相體諒。
grammar: not only A but also B；A 與 B 結構須平行。
be meant to V；have no choice but to V。
can’t help but V = can’t help V-ing。
yet：然而（連接詞）；尚未（否定句副詞）；至今最…（最高級）。
disagree with；deny sb sth；contact with；in return。

groups.title: 10月雜誌 · U1
groups.subtitle: World Vegetarian Day
groups.summary: 世界素食日不只是少吃肉，也讓人思考飲食對健康、動物與地球的影響。活動包括交流食譜、烹飪和共餐。
grammar: when 當關係副詞：先行詞為時間；when + 完整子句。
an amount of + 不可數名詞；a number of + 複數可數名詞。
remove A from B；take part in；be full of。
why not + 原形動詞；keep + O + adj.。
vegetarian 可吃蛋奶；vegan 不吃動物來源食品（以本頁說明為準）。

groups.title: 10月雜誌 · U4
groups.subtitle: Sleep Banking
groups.summary: 睡眠存款指在可能少睡的期間前，提早增加休息。課文呈現不同研究看法，並強調它無法取代固定睡眠習慣。
grammar: while 可表示「儘管」「當…時」「而（對比）」。
使役：make / let / have + O + 原形 V；get + O + to V。
make + O + adj. / N 使…成為／感到…。
compare A to B；remind sb that ...。
ahead of time；build up；pay off。

groups.title: 10月雜誌 · U5
groups.subtitle: Butter Run
groups.summary: 跑者把鮮奶油裝入密封容器，跑步震動使其變成奶油。結果會隨跑步距離、震動強度和乳脂含量而異。
grammar: may / might / must + 原形 V；must 可表示肯定推測。
否定推測常用 may / might not；不是用 must not 表示「一定沒有」。
at the same time；go on；separate out。
depending on；turn A into B。

cards.note: unit n. 單位；unify v. 統一；united adj. 團結的。
cards.example: We should unite, or we'll be defeated by the enemy.
cards.translation: 我們應該團結，否則會被敵人擊敗。

cards.note: 不可數。in unity there is strength；lack of unity。
cards.example: Without unity, we'll face failure.
cards.translation: 沒有團結，我們會面臨失敗。

cards.note: a labor union；a trade union；reunion n. 重聚。
cards.example: The union decided to go on strike due to the low wages.
cards.translation: 工會因薪資低而決定罷工。

cards.note: remain + N / adj. / p.p.；remaining adj. 剩下的；remains n. 遺跡／遺體（複數）。
cards.example: The problem still remains unsolved.
cards.translation: 這個問題仍未解決。

cards.note: probably adv. 可能；probability n. 可能性；likely adj. 很可能的。It seems probable that ...。
cards.example: It seems probable that this accident is the result of the driver's carelessness.
cards.translation: 這場事故似乎很可能是駕駛粗心所造成的。

cards.note: in such a situation；不要寫成 in such situation。
cards.example: This company's financial situation is getting more and more difficult.
cards.translation: 這家公司的財務狀況愈來愈困難。

cards.note: determine to V = resolve to V = make up one's mind to V；determination n. 決心。
cards.example: Lily determined to leave for the hospital at once.
cards.translation: 莉莉決定立刻前往醫院。

cards.note: be determined to V；此處 determined 為形容詞。
cards.example: I'm determined to quit gambling.
cards.translation: 我下定決心戒賭。

cards.note: at any rate = anyway / anyhow；rate sth as ...。
cards.example: This resort is rated as the most beautiful place in the country.
cards.translation: 這個度假勝地被評為全國最美的地方。

cards.note: politically adv. 政治上地；politics n. 政治；politician n. 政治家。
cards.example: Most youngsters are not interested in politics.
cards.translation: 大多數年輕人對政治不感興趣。

cards.note: be in the process of N / V-ing；processed foods 加工食品。
cards.example: We're still in the process of conducting a market survey.
cards.translation: 我們仍在進行市場調查。

cards.note: the / a majority of ...；major adj. 主要的、n. 主修科目、vi. 主修（in）。
cards.example: The majority of residents on the island can only speak their own dialect.
cards.translation: 島上大多數居民只會說自己的方言。

cards.note: 財產不可數；特性可數。possessions / assets 財產；quality 特性。
cards.example: They lost all their property in the fire.
cards.translation: 他們在火災中失去了所有財產。

cards.note: a golden opportunity；broaden one's horizons 拓展視野。
cards.example: This trip is a great opportunity to broaden your horizons and practice your English.
cards.translation: 這趟旅行是拓展視野與練習英文的好機會。

cards.note: = in fact；actual adj. 真實的。
cards.example: Nick likes to act like a teenager, but actually he's more than 30 years old.
cards.translation: 尼克喜歡表現得像青少年，但其實已經三十多歲了。

cards.note: recognize A as B；recognition n. 認出／認可；recognizable adj. 可辨認的。
cards.example: Professor Rollins is recognized as one of the best educators in the country.
cards.translation: 羅林斯教授被認可為全國最好的教育家之一。

cards.note: enjoy v. 喜愛；enjoyment n. 享受；pleasant adj. 愉快的；boring 反義。
cards.example: The party we had last Friday night was really enjoyable.
cards.translation: 上星期五晚上的聚會真的很愉快。

cards.note: joy n. 喜悅；joyfully adv. 喜悅地；joyous adj. 喜悅的。
cards.example: We were excited and joyful, knowing that our team had won the game.
cards.translation: 得知我們的隊伍贏得比賽，我們興奮又喜悅。

cards.note: be unique to + 地方 = be native to / be indigenous to。
cards.example: Kiwi birds are unique to New Zealand.
cards.translation: 奇異鳥是紐西蘭特有的。

cards.note: excellent / fantastic。
cards.example: The restaurant on the corner serves terrific food.
cards.translation: 轉角的餐廳提供很棒的食物。

cards.note: wed–wedded / wed–wedded / wed；marry v. 結婚；the newlyweds 新婚夫婦。
cards.example: They wedded on a beautiful autumn day.
cards.translation: 他們在一個美麗的秋日結婚。

cards.note: be tough on sb 對某人嚴厲；sturdy 堅固的；harsh 嚴厲的。
cards.example: Tom is tough on his son because he thinks his child is a little too naughty.
cards.translation: 湯姆對兒子很嚴格，因為他覺得孩子有點太頑皮。

cards.note: for hire 可供租用；employ 雇用；rent 租用。
cards.example: We hired a consultant to devise a new system for our company.
cards.translation: 我們聘請顧問為公司設計新系統。

cards.note: nostalgic adj. 懷舊的。
cards.example: I couldn't help feeling homesick on sleepless nights.
cards.translation: 在失眠的夜晚，我忍不住感到思鄉。

cards.note: invite v. 邀請；inviting adj. 誘人的；at the invitation of sb 應某人之邀。
cards.example: Mr. Lee joined the group at the invitation of the government.
cards.translation: 李先生應政府邀請加入這個團體。

cards.note: be jealous of；jealously adv. 嫉妒地；envy n. / v. 羨慕；be envious of。
cards.example: Why are you so jealous of David's promotion?
cards.translation: 你為什麼那麼嫉妒大衛的升遷？

cards.note: with fright 害怕地；stage fright 怯場。
cards.example: Sarah has no stage fright; in fact, she enjoys making public speeches.
cards.translation: 莎拉不會怯場；事實上，她喜歡公開演說。

cards.note: frightened 感到害怕的；frightening 令人害怕的；frighten sb into V-ing。
cards.example: Tom frightened Jim into keeping quiet.
cards.translation: 湯姆嚇得吉姆保持安靜。

cards.note: be located in / on / at = be situated in / on / at；location n. 地點。
cards.example: Our school is located in that area.
cards.translation: 我們學校位於那個地區。

cards.note: cost n. / v. 費用／花費；expensive 昂貴的。costly 不是副詞。
cards.example: Money is hard to earn, so I never buy costly clothes.
cards.translation: 錢很難賺，所以我從不買昂貴的衣服。

cards.note: largely / mainly / primarily。
cards.example: John succeeded mostly because he worked hard and had great ambition.
cards.translation: 約翰成功主要是因為他努力又有抱負。

cards.note: 常配現在完成式；= recently / of late。
cards.example: Have you seen James lately?
cards.translation: 你最近見過詹姆斯嗎？

cards.note: besides = in addition to / apart from / aside from + N / V-ing。
cards.example: Besides math, Lucy is good at music.
cards.translation: 除了數學，露西也擅長音樂。

cards.note: a career soldier 職業軍人；a career woman 職業婦女。
cards.example: Ms. Wilson took up photography as her career.
cards.translation: 威爾森女士以攝影為職業。

cards.note: paint n. / v. 油漆／油漆；painting n. 畫。
cards.example: My father used to be a painter but gave it up later.
cards.translation: 我父親以前是畫家，後來放棄了。

cards.note: bank n. 銀行；banking n. 銀行業務。
cards.example: Mr. Emery is a successful banker, but he leads a simple life.
cards.translation: 艾默里先生是成功的銀行家，但生活簡樸。

cards.note: 職稱可與人名連用；注意不同情境的中文意思。
cards.example: The captain said that the plane would be landing soon.
cards.translation: 機長說飛機即將降落。

cards.note: cameraman n. 攝影師。
cards.example: The photographer won an award for his photos of war.
cards.translation: 這位攝影師因戰爭照片而獲獎。

cards.note: manufacturer 製造商；maker 製造者。
cards.example: Tina's ex-husband is a famous film producer.
cards.translation: 蒂娜的前夫是著名的電影製作人。

cards.note: lecturer 講師；associate professor 副教授。
cards.example: Mr. Stevens is a professor of psychology.
cards.translation: 史蒂文斯先生是一位心理學教授。

cards.note: permit sb to V；permit V-ing；allow 同義；ban / prohibit 禁止。
cards.example: We are not permitted to smoke here.
cards.translation: 我們不被允許在此抽菸。

cards.note: without sb's permission = without sb's consent / agreement。
cards.example: You are not allowed to use the machine without my permission.
cards.translation: 沒有我的許可，你不能使用這臺機器。

cards.note: turn the volume up / down；a large volume of + 不可數名詞。
cards.example: Would you mind turning the volume down? I'm studying.
cards.translation: 你介意把音量調小嗎？我正在讀書。

cards.note: represent sth = stand for sth = be a representation of sth；symbolize 象徵。
cards.example: This ring, though inexpensive, represents my love for you.
cards.translation: 這枚戒指雖然便宜，卻代表我對你的愛。

cards.note: be representative of ...。
cards.example: The dove is representative of peace.
cards.translation: 鴿子代表和平。

cards.note: an attitude to / toward(s) sth。
cards.example: Tony has a positive attitude towards life.
cards.translation: 東尼對人生抱持正面態度。

cards.note: reduce sb to V-ing；reduction n. 減少；decrease 減少；increase 增加。
cards.example: Bankruptcy reduced Bruce to begging.
cards.translation: 破產使布魯斯淪為乞丐。

cards.note: genuine adj. 真正的；fake a signature 偽造簽名。
cards.example: Brian was caught using fake money.
cards.translation: 布萊恩使用假鈔被抓。

cards.note: religion n. 宗教；a religious belief 宗教信仰。
cards.example: The rational scientist is very religious.
cards.translation: 這位理性的科學家對宗教非常虔誠。

cards.note: strong adj. 強壯的；strengthen v. 增強；strengths and weaknesses 優缺點。
cards.example: Please analyze the strengths and weaknesses of this proposal.
cards.translation: 請分析這份提案的優點與缺點。

cards.note: weak adj. 虛弱的；weaken v. 減弱；shortcoming 缺點。
cards.example: Math is my weakness, but music is my forte.
cards.translation: 數學是我的弱項，但音樂是我的強項。

cards.note: vary in ...；various adj. 各式各樣的；variation n. 變化；variable adj. 易變的。
cards.example: The weather varies between cool and very hot.
cards.translation: 天氣在涼爽與酷熱之間變化。

cards.note: a variety of / a wide variety of；various + 複數名詞。
cards.example: The library offers a wide variety of books to choose from.
cards.translation: 圖書館提供各式各樣的書可供選擇。

cards.note: produce n. 農產品（不可數）／v. 生產；producer n. 生產者；productivity n. 生產力。
cards.example: The country's main product is timber.
cards.translation: 這個國家的主要產品是木材。

cards.note: image n. 形象／影像；imagine v. 想像；imaginative 有想像力的；imaginary 虛構的。
cards.example: Use your imagination and see if you can come up with a better idea.
cards.translation: 運用想像力，看看能否想出更好的點子。

cards.note: prevent sb / sth from V-ing；prevention n. 預防；preventive adj. 預防的。
cards.example: Robert's sore legs prevented him from joining the marathon.
cards.translation: 羅伯特腿痠，使他無法參加馬拉松。

cards.note: response to；in response to；respond vi. 回應（to）；responsive adj. 有反應的。
cards.example: Has there been any response to your letter?
cards.translation: 你的信有收到任何回覆嗎？

cards.note: take responsibility for N / V-ing；responsible adj. 負責的；irresponsible 不負責任的。
cards.example: You should take responsibility for what you've done.
cards.translation: 你應為自己的所作所為負責。

cards.note: carry out；perform one's duties；performer n. 表演者。
cards.example: The surgeon has performed this operation before.
cards.translation: 這位外科醫師以前做過這種手術。

cards.note: academic performance 學業表現。
cards.example: The famous actress gave a great performance in the play last night.
cards.translation: 這位名演員在昨晚的戲劇中有精彩的演出。

cards.note: method n. 方法；technical adj. 技術的／專門的；a technical term 專業術語。
cards.example: The artist was highly acclaimed for his painting techniques.
cards.translation: 這位藝術家的繪畫技巧廣受讚賞。

cards.note: abnormal adj. 不正常的。
cards.example: It's normal to feel nervous before a test.
cards.translation: 考試前感到緊張是正常的。

cards.note: on your committee；集合名詞。
cards.example: How many members are there on your committee?
cards.translation: 你的委員會有多少成員？

cards.note: achieve goals；achievement n. 成就；accomplish 完成；attain 達到；obtain 獲得。
cards.example: If you work hard, you will eventually achieve your goals.
cards.translation: 如果努力，你終究會達成目標。

cards.note: immediately adv. 立刻；immediately after = shortly after。
cards.example: There was an immediate response to Mary's request.
cards.translation: 瑪麗的請求立刻得到回應。

cards.note: magically adv. 神奇地；magic n. 魔術；magician n. 魔術師。
cards.example: The magician took out a rabbit from his hat.
cards.translation: 魔術師從帽子裡拿出一隻兔子。

cards.note: meet / live up to / measure up to sb's expectations；expect v. 期待。
cards.example: Without hard work, you can't meet your parents' expectations.
cards.translation: 不努力就無法達到父母的期望。

cards.note: an ongoing crisis；an ongoing case。
cards.example: The lawyer refused to comment on the ongoing case.
cards.translation: 律師拒絕評論這件仍在審理中的案件。

cards.meaning: 在下面的；隱含的；根本的
cards.note: underlying meaning 隱含的意義；underlying causes 根本原因。
cards.example: What are the underlying causes of this problem?
cards.translation: 這個問題的根本原因是什麼？

cards.note: the spring / fall semester；term n. 學期。
cards.example: I'm going to take 13 credits this semester.
cards.translation: 我這學期要修十三個學分。

cards.note: 胡椒粉不可數；甜椒可數。red / green pepper。
cards.example: Please pass me the salt and pepper.
cards.translation: 請把鹽和胡椒遞給我。

cards.note: vivid / animated / graphic 生動的。
cards.example: The artist's paintings are very colorful.
cards.translation: 這位畫家的畫作色彩豐富。

cards.note: be fearful of = be afraid of；fear n. 恐懼。
cards.example: John was fearful of losing his job.
cards.translation: 約翰害怕失去工作。

cards.note: hate n. / v. 恨；hatred n. 憎恨。
cards.example: Tom has been a hateful man ever since the accident.
cards.translation: 自從那場事故以後，湯姆就充滿怨恨。

cards.note: feel hopeful about；hopefully adv. 但願；optimistic 樂觀的；hopeless 絕望的。
cards.example: After watching the film, everyone feels hopeful about the future.
cards.translation: 看完電影後，大家都對未來充滿希望。

cards.note: 比較：hopeful、fearful、hateful、skillful。
cards.example: Healthy puppies and kittens are very playful animals.
cards.translation: 健康的小狗與小貓都很愛玩。

cards.note: be skillful at；skillfully adv. 巧妙地；unskillful adj. 技術不佳的。
cards.example: They are skillful at this game.
cards.translation: 他們很擅長這個遊戲。

cards.note: bony 瘦骨嶙峋的；thin 瘦的；slim 纖瘦的；slender 苗條的。
cards.example: Rose is very skinny because she is an incredibly picky eater.
cards.translation: 蘿絲非常瘦，因為她極度挑食。

cards.note: 副詞不加介系詞：go downtown。
cards.example: I am heading downtown.
cards.translation: 我要前往市中心。

cards.note: react to sth；reaction n. 反應（to）。
cards.example: Ted reacted calmly to the plaintiff's accusation.
cards.translation: 泰德冷靜回應原告的指控。

cards.note: raise funds for；fundraiser n. 募款人／募款活動。
cards.example: The hospital is trying to raise funds for research into AIDS.
cards.translation: 醫院正試圖為愛滋病研究募款。

cards.note: a large / small audience；集合名詞。不可用 many / few 表單一場次的人數多寡。
cards.example: The concert drew a large audience.
cards.translation: 演唱會吸引了很多觀眾。

cards.note: morality n. 道德；ethical 道德的；immoral 不道德的；wicked 邪惡的。
cards.example: The moral of this story is that money cannot buy happiness.
cards.translation: 這個故事的寓意是金錢買不到幸福。

cards.note: declare / proclaim；announcement n. 公告；make an announcement that ...。
cards.example: John will announce who will play the characters in the play.
cards.translation: 約翰將宣布誰飾演劇中的角色。

cards.note: in theory 理論上；in practice 實際上；theoretical adj. 理論的。
cards.example: Well, that sounds good in theory, but I don't know if it will work in practice.
cards.translation: 理論上聽來不錯，但我不知道實際上是否可行。

cards.note: go skating；ski n. / vi. 滑雪板／滑雪；go skiing。
cards.example: Would you like to join us in going skating this weekend?
cards.translation: 這個週末你想和我們一起溜冰嗎？

cards.note: structural adj. 結構的；framework n. 架構。
cards.example: The structure of the poem is very complicated.
cards.translation: 這首詩的結構很複雜。

cards.note: a staff of 500 = 500 staff members；be staffed with ...。
cards.example: Our company is staffed with individuals from three different countries.
cards.translation: 公司的人員來自三個不同國家。

cards.note: a crew of twenty = twenty crew members；不是 twenty crews（若指二十位人員）。
cards.example: We have a crew of twenty on our ship.
cards.translation: 我們船上有二十名工作人員。

cards.note: suffer from 疾病／痛苦；suffer a loss 遭受損失。
cards.example: My father suffers from diabetes.
cards.translation: 我父親患有糖尿病。

cards.note: in spite of = despite = notwithstanding + N / V-ing；out of spite 出於怨恨。
cards.example: In spite of his dad's warning, Paul went fishing alone.
cards.translation: 儘管父親警告，保羅仍獨自去釣魚。

cards.note: live a ... lifestyle。
cards.example: The topic of the magazine this month is living a healthy lifestyle.
cards.translation: 這個月雜誌的主題是過健康的生活。

cards.note: somewhat adv. 稍微（修飾形容詞或副詞）。
cards.example: I know the job is difficult, but we have to finish it somehow.
cards.translation: 我知道工作很難，但我們得設法完成。

cards.note: origin n. 起源；originality n. 創意；originate v. 源自；innovative adj. 創新的。
cards.example: Kelly has a very original idea.
cards.translation: 凱莉有很具創意的想法。

cards.note: in the beginning；eventually 最後（反義方向）。
cards.example: We're originally from Texas.
cards.translation: 我們原本來自德州。

cards.note: an additional + 數字 = an extra + 數字；addition n. 增加；add v. 增加。
cards.example: You may have to pay an additional charge for overweight baggage.
cards.translation: 行李超重可能須付額外費用。

cards.note: in addition / on top of that / besides / furthermore / moreover。
cards.example: The rent is cheap. Additionally, the location is perfect.
cards.translation: 租金便宜。此外，地點也非常好。

cards.note: take advantage of sth 利用；take advantage of sb 占某人便宜；disadvantage n. 缺點。
cards.example: All students are invited to take advantage of our student discounts.
cards.translation: 歡迎所有學生使用我們的學生折扣。

cards.note: be specific to + 地方；be specific about ...；specify v. 明確指出；general 一般的。
cards.example: Please be more specific about what you want.
cards.translation: 請更明確說明你要什麼。

cards.note: specially / particularly。
cards.example: The doctor warned Mark specifically not to eat eggs.
cards.translation: 醫生特別警告馬克不要吃蛋。

cards.note: destruction n. 破壞；destructive adj. 破壞性的；damage / ruin；restore 重建。
cards.example: The typhoon destroyed the whole area.
cards.translation: 颱風毀壞了整個地區。

cards.note: columnist n. 專欄作家；a weekly column 每週專欄。
cards.example: Nicole writes a weekly column for The China Post.
cards.translation: 妮可每週為《中國郵報》撰寫專欄。

cards.note: be on a mission；missionary n. 傳教士。
cards.example: Rumor has it that Michael is on a secret mission in Syria.
cards.translation: 據說麥可正在敘利亞執行祕密任務。

cards.note: revelation n. 揭示；conceal vt. 隱瞞（反義）。
cards.example: The agent was jailed for revealing secrets to the enemy.
cards.translation: 特務因向敵人洩密而入獄。

cards.note: subtropical 亞熱帶的；temperate zone 溫帶；frigid zone 寒帶。
cards.example: I have a liking for tropical fruits such as bananas and pineapples.
cards.translation: 我喜歡香蕉和鳳梨等熱帶水果。

cards.note: agricultural adj. 農業的；farming 農業。
cards.example: We are developing new technology to improve our agriculture.
cards.translation: 我們正在研發新科技以改善農業。

cards.note: pull / tow / haul 拉、拖；reduce drag 減少阻力。
cards.example: The new design of the plane will help to reduce drag.
cards.translation: 飛機的新設計有助於減少阻力。

cards.note: drug n. 藥物；毒品。
cards.example: The drugstore is open 24 hours a day.
cards.translation: 這家藥妝店全天營業。

cards.note: have a cough；have a runny nose 流鼻水。
cards.example: Cover your mouth when you cough.
cards.translation: 咳嗽時請遮住嘴巴。

cards.note: feel dizzy。
cards.example: After three glasses of beer, I felt slightly dizzy.
cards.translation: 喝了三杯啤酒後，我有點暈。

cards.note: taste n. / v. 味道／品嚐；delicious / yummy 好吃的。
cards.example: My mother makes very tasty cakes.
cards.translation: 媽媽做的蛋糕很好吃。

cards.note: a nuclear weapon 核武；a lethal / deadly weapon 致命武器。
cards.example: The police found a large number of weapons in the deserted warehouse.
cards.translation: 警方在廢棄倉庫裡找到大量武器。

cards.note: be anxious about = be worried about；be anxious to V = be eager to V；anxiety n. 焦慮。
cards.example: The government is anxious to improve the investment environment.
cards.translation: 政府渴望改善投資環境。

cards.note: flashlight 手電筒；torch 火把；lantern 燈籠；勿混 flesh 肉。
cards.example: That taxi driver flashed his lights impatiently.
cards.translation: 那位計程車司機不耐煩地閃燈。

cards.note: to the naked eye 對肉眼而言；nude / bare。
cards.example: Germs are not visible to the naked eye.
cards.translation: 細菌是肉眼看不見的。

cards.note: sink–sank–sunk；float 浮（反義）。
cards.example: Two boats sank off the coast of the island during the storm.
cards.translation: 暴風雨期間，兩艘船在島嶼外海沉沒。

cards.note: a passenger plane 客機；rider 乘坐者。
cards.example: Several passengers were injured during the bumpy flight.
cards.translation: 好幾名乘客在顛簸的飛行中受傷。

cards.note: unlock v. 開鎖；locker n. 衣物櫃；lockable adj. 可鎖起來的。
cards.example: Always make sure that the door is locked when you leave.
cards.translation: 離開時一定要確認門已上鎖。

cards.note: juice n. 果汁。
cards.example: The apples are big and juicy at this time of the year.
cards.translation: 每年這時候蘋果又大又多汁。

cards.note: neat and tidy；tidy 整潔的；sloppy / untidy 反義。
cards.example: Judy's handwriting is very neat.
cards.translation: 茱蒂的字跡非常工整。

cards.note: be in a relationship；relationship with；relation n. 關係；relate A to B；be related to。
cards.example: Marc and Amy have been in a relationship since their first date four years ago.
cards.translation: 馬克和艾咪自四年前第一次約會起就一直交往。

cards.note: satisfy v. 使滿意；satisfied 感到滿意的；satisfaction n. 滿意；with satisfaction。
cards.example: Billy thinks it is satisfying to drink a big cup of iced tea after he exercises.
cards.translation: 比利覺得運動後喝一大杯冰茶很令人滿意。

cards.note: inspire sb with sth；be inspired by；inspiration n. 靈感；draw inspiration from。
cards.example: Carly was inspired by one of the paintings in the museum and decided to take an art class.
cards.translation: 卡莉受到博物館一幅畫的啟發，決定上美術課。

cards.note: connect with sb；connect A to B；connection between A and B。
cards.example: Jason connected his smartphone to the TV, so he could show his friends some pictures on the bigger screen.
cards.translation: 傑森把手機接上電視，讓朋友在大螢幕上看照片。

cards.note: communicate with；communication n. 溝通；a means of communication 溝通方式。
cards.example: The Internet allows us to communicate quickly and easily with people all over the world.
cards.translation: 網路讓我們能快速輕鬆地與世界各地的人溝通。

cards.note: introduce A to B；introduction n. 介紹；give sb an introduction to。
cards.example: This two-minute video introduces the public to the latest iPhone and its new features.
cards.translation: 這段兩分鐘影片向大眾介紹最新的 iPhone 及其新功能。

cards.note: throughout the year / day；是介系詞。
cards.example: In some countries, like Singapore, the weather stays hot throughout the year.
cards.translation: 在新加坡等國家，天氣全年都很熱。

cards.note: send a text message to sb。
cards.example: Kylie sent a text message to her boss to tell him that she would be ten minutes late for work.
cards.translation: 凱莉傳訊息告訴老闆她上班會遲到十分鐘。

cards.note: refresh oneself with ...。
cards.example: Carl refreshed himself with a large glass of ice-cold water.
cards.translation: 卡爾喝了一大杯冰水恢復精神。

cards.note: romance n. 浪漫愛情故事；develop a romantic relationship。
cards.example: Nicole and Sam were just friends for many years and never developed a romantic relationship.
cards.translation: 妮可和山姆多年來只是朋友，從未發展成戀愛關係。

cards.note: focus on；focus one's mind on。
cards.example: Violet needs to look for a quiet place like the library to study, so she can focus her mind on her books.
cards.translation: 薇歐蕾需要找圖書館等安靜的地方，才能專心讀書。

cards.note: ignorance n. 無知；out of ignorance 出於無知。
cards.example: Grace totally ignored her younger brother as he made silly faces at her.
cards.translation: 弟弟對葛瑞絲做鬼臉時，她完全不理他。

cards.note: pay attention to；draw sb's attention to 把注意力引到。
cards.example: The article draws our attention to the importance of being good parents in today's world.
cards.translation: 這篇文章提醒我們現今做好父母的重要性。

cards.note: deny + V-ing；denied–denied–denying。注意雜誌 U11 的 deny sb sth 是「拒絕給予」。
cards.example: Mr. Lin denied giving a box of candy to his daughter, but Mrs. Lin didn't believe him.
cards.translation: 林先生否認送女兒一盒糖果，但林太太不相信他。

cards.note: respond to；response n. 回應；in response to；make no response to。
cards.example: Chris responded to his mom's Facebook message with a smiling cat sticker.
cards.translation: 克里斯用微笑貓咪貼圖回覆媽媽的臉書訊息。

cards.note: be disappointed with / about / that ...；disappoint v. 使失望；disappointment n. 失望。
cards.example: Fiona was really disappointed that her favorite character died at the end of the movie.
cards.translation: 菲歐娜最喜歡的角色在片尾死去，讓她非常失望。

cards.note: take ... personally；personal adj. 個人的。
cards.example: Please don't take my comment personally. I'm complaining about all the drivers in our country, not just you.
cards.translation: 請別把我的評論當成針對你，我是在抱怨所有駕駛。

cards.note: 強調事實。
cards.example: December is not cold in Australia. In fact, it's the middle of summer.
cards.translation: 澳洲十二月不冷，事實上正值盛夏。

cards.note: go through + 名詞。
cards.example: Bill is going through the list of winners to see if he is one of them.
cards.translation: 比爾查看得獎名單，確認自己是否名列其中。

cards.note: in case + S + V；此處指為可能情況預先準備。
cards.example: Each of the hikers brought an umbrella and a raincoat in case it rained.
cards.translation: 每位登山者都帶了雨傘和雨衣，以防下雨。

cards.note: moreover / furthermore / additionally；in addition to + N / V-ing。
cards.example: Please remember to bring a snack to the party. In addition, you should bring a gift for the birthday boy.
cards.translation: 記得帶點心來派對，另外也要帶禮物給壽星。

cards.note: hang out with sb。
cards.example: Alice and her friends always hang out in a café after school on Fridays.
cards.translation: 艾莉絲和朋友星期五放學後總在咖啡館聚會。

cards.note: turn to sb for help。
cards.example: Tracy always turns to her older sister Ivy when she has a problem with one of her friends.
cards.translation: 崔西與朋友出現問題時，總會向姊姊艾薇求助。

cards.note: take 是動詞，personally 是副詞。
cards.example: Please don't take this personally, but I don't think I like your shirt.
cards.translation: 請別覺得我是在針對你，但我不太喜歡你的襯衫。

cards.note: wonder if + S + V；wonder about + N。
cards.example: Samuel wonders if he will lose some weight after he joins the swimming club.
cards.translation: 山繆想知道加入游泳社後是否會瘦一些。

cards.note: amaze v. 使驚奇；amazed 感到驚奇的；amazement n. 驚奇；in amazement。
cards.example: It's amazing how bright the stars are outside of the city at night!
cards.translation: 城外夜晚的星星亮得驚人！

cards.note: above / below average；in an average of ...；normal / regular（普通的）。
cards.example: Helen usually scores above average on her exams because she always studies much harder than her classmates.
cards.translation: 海倫比同學更用功，所以考試成績通常高於平均。

cards.note: = as a result；表示結果，注意連接句子的標點。
cards.example: The boots were much more expensive than Tina had expected; therefore, she didn't buy them.
cards.translation: 靴子比蒂娜預期貴很多，因此她沒買。

cards.note: nap–napped–napped；napping；take a nap；stay up late 熬夜。
cards.example: Everybody in the Su family likes to take a nap right after lunch on weekends.
cards.translation: 蘇家每個人週末都喜歡午飯後小睡。

cards.note: 與 sink 沉相反。
cards.example: Jenna threw a piece of bread into the pond and watched it float until a fish ate it.
cards.translation: 珍娜把麵包丟进池塘，看著它漂浮直到被魚吃掉。

cards.note: avoid + V-ing；不接 to V。
cards.example: The family avoided getting stuck in the traffic jam by leaving home very early in the morning.
cards.translation: 一家人清晨很早出門，以避免塞車。

cards.note: below the surface；注意在雜誌 U8 也出現。
cards.example: When too many people boarded the little boat, it began to sink below the surface of the water.
cards.translation: 太多人上小船時，它開始往水面下沉。

cards.note: breath n. 呼吸的氣息；breathe 動詞，breath 名詞；out of breath 喘不過氣。
cards.example: It's so nice to go mountain climbing and breathe the fresh air.
cards.translation: 去爬山呼吸新鮮空氣真好。

cards.note: awake–awoke–awoken；keep sb awake。
cards.example: The loud music from the neighbors' party kept the whole family awake all night.
cards.translation: 鄰居派對的大聲音樂讓全家整晚無法入睡。

cards.note: impress sb with sth；impression n. 印象；leave a good impression on sb。
cards.example: Michelle loves to impress her friends with her yo-yo tricks.
cards.translation: 蜜雪兒喜歡用溜溜球技巧讓朋友印象深刻。

cards.note: within walking distance；distant adj. 遙遠的；distant from。
cards.example: If you live in a big city, the downtown area may be distant from your home.
cards.translation: 若住在大城市，市中心可能離家很遠。

cards.note: go on a journey；通常較長的旅程。
cards.example: After high school, the two best friends plan to go on a journey around the world.
cards.translation: 高中畢業後，這兩位好友計畫環遊世界。

cards.note: take flight 起飛；fly 動詞。
cards.example: Baby birds usually take flight for the first time when they are only about two or three weeks old.
cards.translation: 幼鳥大約兩、三週大時通常就首次起飛。

cards.note: a wide variety of；vary in；various adj. 各式各樣的。
cards.example: That store sells a wide variety of children's toys and books.
cards.translation: 那家店出售各式各樣的兒童玩具和書籍。

cards.note: a living creature。
cards.example: Nick is kind-hearted. He wouldn't hurt any living creature, not even a mosquito.
cards.translation: 尼克很善良，不會傷害任何生物，連蚊子也不會。

cards.note: an expert in ...。
cards.example: Mr. Yang is an expert in math. I'm glad to have him as my tutor.
cards.translation: 楊先生是數學專家，我很高興由他當家教。

cards.note: survival n. 生存；a chance of survival；注意沒有 survive from 這裡的用法。
cards.example: Fortunately, all 103 passengers survived the plane crash.
cards.translation: 幸好一百零三名乘客全都在空難中倖存。

cards.note: hold on to + N。
cards.example: It is a good idea to hold on to one of the poles while you are standing on a moving bus.
cards.translation: 站在行進中的公車上，最好緊抓扶桿。

cards.note: look out for + N。
cards.example: Make sure to look out for bees when you go hiking in the forest.
cards.translation: 在森林健行時，要留意蜜蜂。

cards.note: be on the lookout for + N。
cards.example: Be on the lookout for falling rocks when you drive through the mountains after a rainstorm.
cards.translation: 暴雨後開車經過山區時，務必留意落石。

cards.note: = for instance；take sb as an example。
cards.example: Katie has a really good memory. For example, she can memorize a short passage after she reads it once.
cards.translation: 凱蒂記憶力很好，例如短文讀一次就能記住。

cards.note: according to + 名詞。
cards.example: According to this news report, the whole village was ruined by the earthquake.
cards.translation: 根據這篇新聞報導，整個村莊都被地震毀壞。

cards.note: up to + 數量。
cards.example: Amazingly, some swimmers can hold their breath for up to twenty minutes.
cards.translation: 令人驚訝的是，有些泳者能閉氣長達二十分鐘。

cards.note: stage performance 舞臺表演。
cards.example: Opera and musicals are both dramatic stage performances that combine music and storytelling.
cards.translation: 歌劇與音樂劇都是結合音樂和說故事的戲劇舞臺表演。

cards.note: performer n. 表演者；perform v. 表演／執行。
cards.example: Everyone agreed that last night's performance of Romeo and Juliet was the theater's best yet.
cards.translation: 大家都認為昨晚《羅密歐與茱麗葉》的表演是劇院至今最好的演出。

cards.note: line 在課文指「臺詞」。
cards.example: There is almost no spoken dialogue.
cards.translation: 幾乎沒有口說對話。

cards.note: = mainly；primary adj. 主要的。
cards.example: The focus of opera is primarily on music and vocal power.
cards.translation: 歌劇主要著重音樂與聲音力量。

cards.note: skill n. 技能；highly skilled。
cards.example: Lily is a skilled chess player who has won matches all over the world.
cards.translation: 莉莉是技術純熟的西洋棋選手，曾在世界各地贏得比賽。

cards.note: without microphones；opera / composer / orchestra。
cards.example: Unlike opera, musical performers usually use microphones.
cards.translation: 與歌劇不同，音樂劇表演者通常使用麥克風。

cards.note: the 19th century 十九世紀。
cards.example: They are a modern type of show from the 19th century.
cards.translation: 它們是起源於十九世紀的現代表演類型。

cards.note: develop from ...。
cards.example: These shows developed from entertaining stage plays and popular songs.
cards.translation: 這些表演由娛樂性的舞臺劇和流行歌曲發展而來。

cards.note: emotional adj. 情緒的；emotion n. 情感；intense 強烈的。
cards.example: They sing at important moments—for example, when the story becomes emotionally intense.
cards.translation: 他們在重要時刻唱歌，例如故事情感變得強烈時。

cards.note: 與 Core U3 的集合名詞用法一起背。
cards.example: The band played all their famous songs and really pleased the audience.
cards.translation: 樂團演奏了所有名曲，讓觀眾非常滿意。

cards.note: vary v. 變化；various 各式各樣；variety n. 種類。
cards.example: It also allows these performers to use varied singing styles.
cards.translation: 這也讓表演者能使用多樣的歌唱風格。

cards.note: share the same purpose 具有相同目的。
cards.example: Still, both styles share the same purpose: they use great music and performance to tell a story.
cards.translation: 儘管如此，兩种形式有相同目的：用精彩的音樂與表演說故事。

cards.note: set A apart from B。
cards.example: However, their history and style set them apart.
cards.translation: 然而，它們的歷史與風格使兩者有所不同。

cards.note: look into sth。
cards.example: The elevator isn't working, so I called the building manager to look into the problem.
cards.translation: 電梯故障了，所以我請大樓管理員調查問題。

cards.note: = happen。
cards.example: It usually takes place in opera houses and is a very important part of classical music.
cards.translation: 它通常在歌劇院演出，也是古典音樂非常重要的一部分。

cards.note: play a central / important role in。
cards.example: Family support plays an important role in helping children feel safe at home.
cards.translation: 家庭支持對孩子在家中感到安全有重要作用。

cards.note: = to sum up；與下文總結連用。
cards.example: In conclusion, opera is mainly about classical singing and music, but musicals blend speaking, singing, and dancing.
cards.translation: 總之，歌劇主要是古典歌唱與音樂，音樂劇則融合說話、歌唱和舞蹈。

cards.note: buzz through / around / past。
cards.example: My friends and I buzzed around the school library and looked for books we needed.
cards.translation: 我和朋友在學校圖書館快速穿梭，尋找需要的書。

cards.note: convenient adj. 便利的。
cards.example: I love online shopping for its convenience—I can buy what I want without going to the store.
cards.translation: 我喜歡網購的便利，不用去店裡就能買想要的東西。

cards.note: stuck in sth；get stuck in traffic。
cards.example: Cars often get stuck in traffic, but scooters can weave between them or move through narrow alleys.
cards.translation: 汽車常陷入車陣，但機車能穿梭其中或通過狹窄巷弄。

cards.note: weave–weaved–weaved（穿梭）；編織常用 wove–woven。
cards.example: Hudson weaved through the crowded market and stepped from side to side to avoid people in his path.
cards.translation: 哈德森在擁擠市場穿梭，左右閃避擋路的人。

cards.note: afford v. 負擔得起；much cheaper。
cards.example: Another reason is that scooters are more affordable.
cards.translation: 另一原因是機車更容易負擔。

cards.note: rhythm n. 節奏；registered adj. 已登記的。
cards.example: In Taiwan, a scooter is more than just a vehicle; it's part of the rhythm of daily life.
cards.translation: 在臺灣，機車不只是交通工具，也是日常生活節奏的一部分。

cards.note: imported adj. 進口的。
cards.example: Taiwan mainly depended on imported scooters.
cards.translation: 臺灣主要依賴進口機車。

cards.note: wealthy adj. 富有的。
cards.example: Owning one was often a sign of wealth.
cards.translation: 擁有一輛機車常是財富的象徵。

cards.note: replace A with B（補充搭配）。
cards.example: As cities grew, scooters replaced bicycles as a common choice for daily travel.
cards.translation: 隨著城市成長，機車取代自行車，成為日常交通的常見選擇。

cards.note: environment n. 環境。
cards.example: Environmental concerns, new technology, and changing traffic policies are shaping its future.
cards.translation: 環保考量、新科技與變動中的交通政策正塑造它的未來。

cards.note: thanks to technology；evolve v. 逐漸發展。
cards.example: Thanks to technology, Nora can talk to her cousin in Canada through a video call.
cards.translation: 拜科技所賜，諾拉能用視訊和加拿大的表親說話。

cards.note: electric scooter brands 電動機車品牌。
cards.example: Electric scooter brands like Gogoro are becoming more common.
cards.translation: 像 Gogoro 這樣的電動機車品牌日益普及。

cards.note: as of + 時間。
cards.example: As of Monday, 15 students have signed up for the field trip to the zoo.
cards.translation: 截至星期一，十五位學生已報名動物園校外教學。

cards.note: take shape over time。
cards.example: Taiwan's scooter culture took shape over time.
cards.translation: 臺灣的機車文化隨時間逐漸成形。

cards.note: over time 非 overtime（加班）。
cards.example: Since the new train station opened, the small town grew busier over time.
cards.translation: 新火車站啟用後，小鎮逐漸變得繁忙。

cards.note: depend on sth / sb。
cards.example: Babies are very small and helpless, so they depend on their parents for most things in life.
cards.translation: 嬰兒很小且無助，因此生活大多依賴父母。

cards.note: 可指物理距離或能力／金錢無法達成。
cards.example: Scooters were basically out of reach for most people.
cards.translation: 對大多數人而言，機車基本上是買不起的。

cards.note: graduation n. 畢業；graduate from（補充搭配）。
cards.example: As a graduate from a top university, Hans had several job offers from big companies.
cards.translation: 身為頂尖大學畢業生，漢斯收到幾家大公司的工作邀請。

cards.note: feel forced to V；force v. 強迫。
cards.example: In many countries, high school graduates feel forced to choose between continuing their education and starting their working life.
cards.translation: 在許多國家，高中畢業生覺得不得不在升學與就業間選擇。

cards.note: a path to ...；follow a different path。
cards.example: In Germany, however, many young people follow a different path: the dual education system.
cards.translation: 然而在德國，許多年輕人走不同的道路：雙軌教育制度。

cards.note: theory of their future career。
cards.example: There, they learn the theory of their future career.
cards.translation: 在那裡，他們學習未來職業的理論。

cards.note: 與 Core U1 相互複習。
cards.example: Jack started his teaching career at a small school in Xiangshan. Now, he's a principal at a school in Hsinchu.
cards.translation: 傑克從香山的一所小學校開始教職，如今是新竹一所學校的校長。

cards.note: industries 複數；vocational adj. 技職的；workplace 工作場所。
cards.example: Because companies in different industries help shape the training, students can be sure they're learning skills businesses actually need.
cards.translation: 不同產業的公司參與規劃訓練，學生能確定學到企業真正需要的技能。

cards.note: a monthly salary；month n. 月。
cards.example: On top of that, they receive a monthly salary.
cards.translation: 此外，他們還能領到月薪。

cards.note: salary 可數；a pay raise 加薪。
cards.example: Nina checks her salary carefully because she just got a pay raise.
cards.translation: 妮娜剛加薪，因此仔細查看薪資。

cards.note: employer 雇主（補充辨別）；regular employee 正職員工。
cards.example: Because of Nathan's hard work, he was voted the company's best employee last month.
cards.translation: 納森工作努力，上個月獲選為公司最佳員工。

cards.note: further studies 進修；further information。
cards.example: Plus, the certificate students earn is accepted across the country and can even open doors to further studies.
cards.translation: 此外，證書全國通用，甚至能開啟進一步升學的機會。

cards.note: apply to colleges；apply for 職位／計畫（補充）。
cards.example: Dennis applied to several colleges around Taiwan, and he is waiting to see which ones accept him.
cards.translation: 丹尼斯申請臺灣幾所大學，正在等錄取結果。

cards.note: 與 Core U2 的 attitude toward(s) 合背。
cards.example: This social attitude is what keeps the dual education system going.
cards.translation: 這種社會態度讓雙軌教育制度持續運作。

cards.note: depending on the type of job。
cards.example: The training usually lasts around two to three and a half years, depending on the type of job.
cards.translation: 訓練通常持續約兩年到三年半，視工作類型而定。

cards.meaning: 範圍從 A 到 B
cards.note: range from A to B (to C)。
cards.example: This system covers over 320 different careers, which range from game design to healthcare to banking.
cards.translation: 制度涵蓋三百二十多種職業，從遊戲設計、醫療到銀行業都有。

cards.note: open the door to ...。
cards.example: Studying abroad may open the door to many exciting experiences and personal growth.
cards.translation: 留學可能帶來許多精彩經驗與個人成長機會。

cards.note: keep sth going。
cards.example: Ellie posts new videos every week to keep her online cooking channel going.
cards.translation: 艾莉每週上傳新影片，持續經營線上烹飪頻道。

cards.note: a collection of ...。
cards.example: This book is a collection of ten short stories about animals and families.
cards.translation: 這本書是十篇關於動物與家庭的短篇故事集。

cards.note: murder mystery 推理小說；可作動詞（補充）。
cards.example: Helen heard about the murder on the news and was worried about safety in her town.
cards.translation: 海倫在新聞得知謀殺案，擔心鎮上的安全。

cards.note: = far away。
cards.example: Liam's family lives in a remote mountain area far from any city.
cards.translation: 利安一家住在遠離城市的偏遠山區。

cards.note: an elderly woman；the elderly 老年人（補充）。
cards.example: Miss Marple, on the other hand, is an elderly woman who solves crimes by using her life experience.
cards.translation: 另一方面，瑪波小姐是運用人生經驗破案的年長女性。

cards.note: mysterious adj. 神祕的；mystery n. 謎團。
cards.example: Agatha Christie wrote many mysteries, and interestingly, she became part of one herself.
cards.translation: 阿嘉莎寫了許多推理故事，有趣的是她自己也成為謎團的一部分。

cards.note: physical strength 身體力量；sharp mind 敏銳的頭腦。
cards.example: A sharp mind is more powerful than physical strength.
cards.translation: 敏銳的頭腦比體力更有力量。

cards.note: go missing；miss v. 未注意到；Miss + 姓氏（未婚女性稱謂）。
cards.example: During this difficult time, she suddenly went missing for 11 days.
cards.translation: 在這段艱難時期，她突然失蹤十一天。

cards.note: ordinary citizens 一般民眾。
cards.example: Many people, from police officers to ordinary citizens, joined the search for her.
cards.translation: 許多人從警察到一般民眾，都加入搜索。

cards.note: claim + that 子句。
cards.example: Her husband claimed she had lost her memory during those days.
cards.translation: 她丈夫聲稱她在那些日子失去了記憶。

cards.note: 課文這裡是「提出／暗示一個說法」，不是建議做某事。
cards.example: However, a popular theory suggested that she had disappeared on purpose to punish her cheating husband.
cards.translation: 然而，普遍的說法認為她刻意消失，以懲罰不忠的丈夫。

cards.note: suspect sb of N / V-ing。
cards.example: The teacher suspects Miles of cheating because his answers look exactly like Quinn's.
cards.translation: 老師懷疑麥爾斯作弊，因為答案和昆恩一模一樣。

cards.note: = disappear。
cards.example: Even today, no one knows exactly why she vanished.
cards.translation: 即使到今天，仍沒人確切知道她為何消失。

cards.note: be known for N / V-ing。
cards.example: She was an English author who is known for her detective novels and short-story collections.
cards.translation: 她是一位以偵探小說和短篇故事集聞名的英國作家。

cards.note: in addition to + N / V-ing；in addition 單獨當轉承。
cards.example: The café offers high-quality coffee. In addition, fresh bread and juice are available every morning.
cards.translation: 咖啡館提供高品質咖啡。此外，每天早上都有新鮮麵包與果汁。

cards.note: = for example。
cards.example: For instance, Hercule Poirot, a smart Belgian detective, always notices small details that others miss.
cards.translation: 例如聰明的比利時偵探白羅，總能注意到別人忽略的小細節。

cards.note: 用於比較不同面向；不是 on the contrary 的完全相反。
cards.example: On the other hand, the blue bag is a better deal.
cards.translation: 另一方面，藍色包更划算。

cards.note: check in at a hotel。
cards.example: Surprisingly, she had checked in at the hotel under the surname of her husband's mistress.
cards.translation: 令人驚訝的是，她用丈夫情婦的姓氏入住飯店。

cards.note: purpose n. 目的。
cards.example: The boy dropped the basketball on purpose to stop the game for a minute.
cards.translation: 男孩故意讓籃球掉落，使比賽暫停一下。

cards.note: 可放句首銜接結果。
cards.example: Keep your room tidy. This way, you'll always be able to find things easily when you need them.
cards.translation: 保持房間整齊，如此一來需要東西時就能輕鬆找到。

cards.note: on a surface；與課本 U3 合背。
cards.example: The surface of the new phone feels smooth and cold.
cards.translation: 新手機的表面摸起來光滑冰涼。

cards.note: dirty adj. 骯髒的；dirt 不可數。
cards.example: These tiny, hard parts can get into small cracks on a surface and take the dirt out.
cards.translation: 這些微小堅硬的部分能進入表面細縫，帶出污垢。

cards.note: stubborn stains 頑固污漬。
cards.example: The kitchen now has a stubborn smell after Ben cooked fish for dinner last night.
cards.translation: 班昨晚煮魚當晚餐後，廚房留下難以去除的氣味。

cards.note: a few wipes 幾次擦拭。
cards.example: Mason gave his glasses a quick wipe with his shirt.
cards.translation: 梅森用襯衫快速擦了擦眼鏡。

cards.note: firm enough to V；此處不是公司（n.）。
cards.example: The sponge is firm enough to be cut into small pieces without falling apart.
cards.translation: 海綿夠結實，能切成小塊而不散開。

cards.note: a handy helper；see A as B 把 A 視為 B。
cards.example: For these reasons, many families see the melamine sponge as a handy helper around the house.
cards.translation: 因此許多家庭把科技海綿視為居家好幫手。

cards.note: suitable for sth / sb。
cards.example: Even though melamine sponges are popular, they aren't suitable for every material.
cards.translation: 雖然科技海綿很流行，卻不是每種材質都適合。

cards.note: texture n. 質地；scratch n. / v. 刮痕／刮傷。
cards.example: These watches cost more because they are made of more expensive materials like gold and silver.
cards.translation: 這些手錶用金銀等較貴材料製成，因此價格較高。

cards.note: shiny surfaces；shine v. 發光（補充字族）。
cards.example: Their rough texture can damage shiny surfaces.
cards.translation: 粗糙質地可能損傷有光澤的表面。

cards.note: It's advisable to V；不是 advised 的同義詞性。
cards.example: Because of this, it's advisable to test the sponge on a small area before using it on the whole surface.
cards.translation: 因此，整面使用前宜先在小區域測試。

cards.note: break into smaller pieces。
cards.example: As people use it, the sponge gradually breaks into smaller pieces.
cards.translation: 使用時，海綿會逐漸碎成更小的塊。

cards.note: harmful to；harm n. / v. 傷害（補充字族）。
cards.example: When this happens, the sponge may give off harmful particles.
cards.translation: 此時海綿可能釋出有害微粒。

cards.note: 亦可 have difficulty / problems / a hard time (in) V-ing。
cards.example: Do you have trouble removing dirty spots?
cards.translation: 你有去除髒污的困擾嗎？

cards.note: apart adv. 分開。
cards.example: The old house is falling apart—the roof, the windows, and the floors all need to be fixed.
cards.translation: 老房子正逐漸破損，屋頂、窗戶和地板都需修理。

cards.note: even though + S + V。
cards.example: Even though the soup was cold, Anna still ate it because she was very hungry.
cards.translation: 即使湯冷了，安娜很餓，還是喝了。

cards.note: come off sth。
cards.example: The button may come off your coat if you pull it too hard.
cards.translation: 拉得太用力，鈕扣可能會從外套上掉下來。

cards.note: keep sth in mind。
cards.example: There is also a safety concern to keep in mind.
cards.translation: 還有一個安全問題需要留意。

cards.note: 與 break into / fall apart 區分語意。
cards.example: Hot water and oil can make the sponge break down faster.
cards.translation: 熱水和油會讓海綿更快分解。

cards.note: give off sth。
cards.example: When the wood started burning, it began to give off a lot of heat and smoke.
cards.translation: 木頭燃燒後，開始散發大量熱和煙。

cards.note: be no exception 也不例外。
cards.example: Every cleaning tool has its pros and cons, and the melamine sponge is no exception.
cards.translation: 每種清潔工具都有優缺點，科技海綿也不例外。

cards.note: active adj. 積極的（補充字族）。
cards.example: Many governments are actively encouraging people to have more babies.
cards.translation: 許多政府正積極鼓勵人們多生孩子。

cards.note: complaint about sb / sth；make a complaint。
cards.example: When another worker was rude to her in a meeting, she made a complaint to Margaret in the break room.
cards.translation: 另一員工開會時對她無禮，她便在休息室向瑪格麗特抱怨。

cards.note: = often；frequency n. 頻率（補充）。
cards.example: Kevin frequently goes to the gym—about six times a week.
cards.translation: 凱文常去健身房，大約每週六次。

cards.note: lose their appeal 失去吸引力。
cards.example: For example, fine restaurants, museums, or art shows may lose their appeal when children are running and shouting.
cards.translation: 例如高級餐廳、博物館或藝術展，在兒童奔跑叫喊時可能失去吸引力。

cards.note: pay for comfort；comfortable adj. 舒適的（補充）。
cards.example: In such cases, customers pay not only for service but also for comfort.
cards.translation: 這種情況下，顧客不只為服務付費，也為舒適付費。

cards.note: set policies；複數 policies。
cards.example: Many also believe business owners should have the right to set their own policies.
cards.translation: 許多人也認為店主應有權制定自己的規則。

cards.note: disagree with sth / sb；oppose v. 反對。
cards.example: Others disagree with these limits.
cards.translation: 另一些人不同意這些限制。

cards.note: deny sb sth；課本 U2 deny V-ing 則為否認。
cards.example: They believe children are members of society and should not be denied entry.
cards.translation: 他們認為兒童是社會成員，不應被拒絕進入。

cards.note: deny entry；No Entry 禁止進入。
cards.example: A big sign by the door says “No Entry” to stop people from going in.
cards.translation: 門旁大告示寫著「禁止進入」，阻止人們進去。

cards.note: contact with sb / sth；have less contact with。
cards.example: As the number of children declines, adults may have less contact with them.
cards.translation: 隨著兒童人數下降，成人與他們的接觸可能變少。

cards.note: weak adj. 弱的；weakness n. 弱點。
cards.example: This distance might weaken people's patience and understanding toward children.
cards.translation: 這種距離可能削弱人們對兒童的耐心與理解。

cards.note: patient adj. 有耐心的（補充字族）；與 patient n. 病人區分。
cards.example: The president left quickly because he didn't have the patience to answer so many questions from the reporters.
cards.translation: 總統不耐煩回答記者那麼多問題，因此迅速離開。

cards.note: be meant to V。
cards.example: Supporters of this idea argue that some places are meant to remain calm and quiet.
cards.translation: 支持者主張，有些場所本來就應保持平靜安靜。

cards.note: shut sb out。
cards.example: Such policies are not about shutting children out.
cards.translation: 這些規則並不是為了排斥兒童。

cards.note: look after sb / sth。
cards.example: Jamie agreed to look after his friend's dog when his friend was on vacation in France.
cards.translation: 朋友在法國度假時，傑米答應照顧他的狗。

cards.note: bring sb / sth along。
cards.example: When that happens, they have no choice but to bring their children along.
cards.translation: 發生這種情況時，他們只能帶著孩子一起來。

cards.note: keep sb / sth out of sth。
cards.example: Parents should keep young children out of the swimming pool when there is no responsible adult watching nearby.
cards.translation: 沒有負責的成人在旁看顧時，父母應阻止幼兒進入泳池。

cards.note: a way forward。
cards.example: Perhaps the best way forward is shared effort.
cards.translation: 也許最好的辦法是共同努力。

cards.note: give patience in return。
cards.example: Parents can guide their children, while other adults offer patience in return.
cards.translation: 家長可以引導孩子，其他成人則以耐心相待。

cards.note: have little choice but to V。
cards.example: You have little choice but to rewrite the report by Friday.
cards.translation: 你幾乎沒有其他選擇，只能在星期五前重寫報告。

cards.note: 文中不是觀察；老師補充 watch / see／celebrate 等對照。
cards.example: Every year on October 1, people around the world observe World Vegetarian Day.
cards.translation: 每年十月一日，世界各地的人慶祝世界素食日。

cards.note: 複數 possibilities；endless adj. 無盡的。
cards.example: It celebrates the joy, kindness, and endless possibilities of vegetarian living.
cards.translation: 它歌頌素食生活的喜悅、善意與無限可能。

cards.note: awareness of；aware adj. 意識到的（補充）。
cards.example: The goal of this project is to increase awareness of daily exercise and encourage kids to play outside more often.
cards.translation: 計畫旨在提高每日運動意識，鼓勵孩子多到戶外玩。

cards.note: meaning n. 意義（補充）；simple but meaningful。
cards.example: On World Vegetarian Day, people take part in simple but meaningful activities.
cards.translation: 世界素食日當天，人們參與簡單卻有意義的活動。

cards.note: exchange recipes / ideas。
cards.example: After the students read the book, they exchanged ideas with each other to understand the story better.
cards.translation: 學生讀完書後交換想法，以更理解故事。

cards.note: remove A from B。
cards.example: World Vegetarian Day is not simply about removing meat from the menu.
cards.translation: 世界素食日不只是把肉從菜單移除。

cards.note: a balanced diet；balance n. / v. 平衡（補充）。
cards.example: A balanced vegetarian diet usually includes vegetables, fruits, beans, grains, nuts, and seeds.
cards.translation: 均衡素食通常包含蔬菜、水果、豆類、穀物、堅果與種子。

cards.note: whole grains 全穀類。
cards.example: Whole grains like brown rice are healthier than white rice.
cards.translation: 糙米等全穀類比白米更健康。

cards.note: vitamin C / E；fiber 纖維；mineral 礦物質。
cards.example: We mainly get vitamin D from the sun, but it's also added to milk.
cards.translation: 維生素 D 主要由日照獲得，也會添加到牛奶裡。

cards.note: 與 Core U3 suffer from 合背。
cards.example: By eating less meat, people hope fewer animals will suffer.
cards.translation: 藉由少吃肉，人們希望減少動物受苦。

cards.note: benefit sb；也可名詞「益處」（補充）。
cards.example: Vegetarian meals can benefit the planet as well.
cards.translation: 素食餐點也能對地球有益。

cards.note: animal agriculture 畜牧業；greenhouse gases 溫室氣體。
cards.example: Animal agriculture also produces greenhouse gases.
cards.translation: 畜牧業也會產生溫室氣體。

cards.note: = participate in（補充）。
cards.example: Thousands of students took part in the school's sports day and enjoyed all the fun activities.
cards.translation: 數千位學生參與運動會，享受所有有趣活動。

cards.note: be full of + N。
cards.example: It can be colorful, creative, and full of flavor!
cards.translation: 它可以色彩豐富、有創意又充滿風味！

cards.note: why not + V，提出建議。
cards.example: On World Vegetarian Day, why not take a closer look at the menu and try a meatless dish?
cards.translation: 世界素食日何不仔細看看菜單，試試無肉料理？

cards.note: take a closer look at 更仔細看。
cards.example: Hannah took a look at the weather report before she left for school today.
cards.translation: 漢娜今天上學前看了一下天氣報告。

cards.note: lose focus；keep one's focus on。
cards.example: When people don't get enough sleep, they feel exhausted, lose focus easily, and can't remember things well.
cards.translation: 睡眠不足會疲憊、易失去專注，且記不清事情。

cards.note: affect 動詞；effect 名詞（补充辨別）。
cards.example: While these problems affect people's daily lives, some researchers point to one possible way to help: sleep banking.
cards.translation: 雖然這些問題影響日常生活，一些研究者指出可行方式：睡眠存款。

cards.note: daily lives；a daily walk。
cards.example: Craig's daily walk by the river helps him feel calm before a busy day of work.
cards.translation: 克雷格每天沿河散步，讓他在忙碌工作前感到平靜。

cards.note: lose v. 失去；sleep loss 睡眠不足。
cards.example: Sleep banking means getting extra sleep before a period of sleep loss begins.
cards.translation: 睡眠存款是在一段睡眠不足期間開始前增加睡眠。

cards.note: make a deposit 存入金額。
cards.example: Ben makes a monthly deposit into his bank account to pay for next year's trip.
cards.translation: 班每月存錢，準備明年的旅行費。

cards.note: savings account 儲蓄帳戶。
cards.example: I'm trying to put more money into my savings so that I can buy a house in the future.
cards.translation: 我努力多存錢，以便將來買房。

cards.note: compare A to B；compare A with B 對照（補充）。
cards.example: Some researchers compare sleep to a piggy bank and believe people can save extra rest for later.
cards.translation: 一些研究者把睡眠比作撲滿，認為能預存休息。

cards.note: sleep debt 睡眠債。
cards.example: Others think sleep is more like a credit card: you can build up “sleep debt” by sleeping too little.
cards.translation: 另一些人覺得睡眠像信用卡，睡太少就累積睡眠債。

cards.note: instead of + N / V-ing（補充）。
cards.example: I decided not to eat pizza for lunch. Instead, I had a sandwich.
cards.translation: 我決定午餐不吃披薩，改吃三明治。

cards.note: remind sb that ...；remind sb to V（補充）。
cards.example: Some researchers also remind people that sleep debt should be paid off as soon as possible.
cards.translation: 一些研究者也提醒人們，睡眠債應盡快還清。

cards.note: short-term situations 短期情況。
cards.example: Overall, sleep banking can be useful, but it works best only for short-term situations.
cards.translation: 整體而言睡眠存款可能有用，但最適合短期情況。

cards.note: a regular sleep schedule。
cards.example: It cannot replace a regular sleep schedule.
cards.translation: 它無法取代規律的睡眠作息。

cards.note: point to sth。
cards.example: Experts point to recent studies to show the danger of teenagers sharing too much personal data online.
cards.translation: 專家引用近期研究，說明青少年網路分享過多個資的危險。

cards.note: build up sth。
cards.example: The new manager slowly built up the team's trust by keeping every promise he made.
cards.translation: 新經理信守每個承諾，慢慢建立團隊信任。

cards.note: stay up late。
cards.example: For example, students might know they have to stay up late for an important exam.
cards.translation: 例如學生可能知道自己得為重要考試熬夜。

cards.note: in that case 在那種情況下。
cards.example: In this case, they can start going to bed earlier about a week before the exam.
cards.translation: 此時，他們可在考前約一週開始提早睡。

cards.note: = in advance（補充）。
cards.example: However, you cannot store extra sleep ahead of time.
cards.translation: 然而，你無法提前儲存額外睡眠。

cards.note: pay sth off。
cards.example: Lucy sold her old furniture to help pay off the bills that had piled up.
cards.translation: 露西賣舊家具，以支付累積的帳單。

cards.note: playful challenge 有趣的挑戰。
cards.example: This playful challenge has drawn attention online because it lets runners burn calories while they churn some fresh butter.
cards.translation: 這項有趣挑戰在網路引起注意，因為跑者能燃燒熱量又攪製奶油。

cards.note: an online challenge。
cards.example: Ella joined an online dance challenge that asked people to copy a short, funny set of moves.
cards.translation: 艾拉參加網路舞蹈挑戰，模仿一套短而有趣的動作。

cards.note: pour A into B；heavy cream 鮮奶油。
cards.example: Runners pour heavy cream into a sealed container and carry it while they run.
cards.translation: 跑者將鮮奶油倒入密封容器，跑步時帶著。

cards.note: sealed adj. 密封的；container n. 容器。
cards.example: You should seal that bottle carefully so the water doesn't leak into your bag.
cards.translation: 你應仔細密封瓶子，以免水漏進袋子。

cards.note: 也可當 n. 液體；solid 固態的。
cards.example: The solid part becomes butter, and the liquid part becomes buttermilk.
cards.translation: 固體部分變成奶油，液體部分變成酪乳。

cards.note: 與 Core U2、課本 U3 的字族合背。
cards.example: The results can vary depending on running distance, shaking intensity, and the cream's fat level.
cards.translation: 結果因跑步距離、震動強度和鮮奶油脂肪量而異。

cards.note: while + S + V 也可表同時。
cards.example: Do you want to exercise and make food at the same time?
cards.translation: 你想同時運動又製作食物嗎？

cards.note: as the run goes on。
cards.example: As the run goes on, fat molecules in the cream start to stick together.
cards.translation: 隨跑步持續，奶油中的脂肪分子開始黏在一起。

cards.note: separate A from B（補充）。
cards.example: After you shake the bottle, leave it on the table for a while. The oil and water will slowly separate out.
cards.translation: 搖瓶後放一會兒，油與水會慢慢分離。

cards.note: depending on sth。
cards.example: Carol may wear a coat or a T-shirt, depending on the weather.
cards.translation: 卡蘿會依天氣穿外套或 T 恤。

cards.note: turn sth / sb into sth / sb。
cards.example: By turning a regular run into something fun, the butter run may help people enjoy exercise more!
cards.translation: 把普通跑步變有趣，奶油跑可能讓人更喜歡運動！

cards.note: memory n. 回憶／記憶；memorize (US) / memorise (UK) v. 記憶；memorable 是形容經驗，memorized 指「被記住的」。
cards.example: There were some memorable moments, too.
cards.translation: 也有一些難忘的時刻。

cards.note: 美式拼法 memorize；英式拼法 memorise。memorize V-ing。
cards.example: Nancy is good at memorizing texts within a very short period of time, but she usually forgets them after a few days.
cards.translation: 南希很會在短時間內記住文章，但通常幾天後就忘記。

cards.note: make memories 留下回憶；from memory 憑記憶；childhood memories 童年回憶。
cards.example: Fiona has a really good memory. She can remember most of her best friends’ phone numbers.
cards.translation: 菲歐娜記性很好，能記得大多數好友的電話號碼。

cards.note: reply to + 人／事；in reply to + 問題；reply that + 子句。注意不是 reply someone。
cards.example: In reply to your question about my health, I am feeling much better now.
cards.translation: 關於你詢問我健康的問題，我現在好多了。

cards.note: yell at sb 對某人大喊；文中祖母大聲叫 Robbie 試吃牛肉麵。
cards.example: She yelled at me to try her perfect beef noodles.
cards.translation: 她大聲叫我試吃她做的完美牛肉麵。

cards.note: in perfect condition 狀況完好。老師在課文圈出 perfect。
cards.example: John was very careful with his car, so it was still in perfect condition after five years of use.
cards.translation: 約翰很愛惜車子，所以用了五年後仍狀況完好。

cards.note: accident n. 意外／事故；accidental adj. 意外的；副詞以 -ly 結尾。
cards.example: Sheila accidentally spilled coffee on her new dress, and it left a mark.
cards.translation: 雪拉不小心把咖啡灑在新洋裝上，留下污漬。

cards.note: 可數／不可數；反義詞 success；a total failure；end in failure。
cards.example: The meeting was a total failure since nothing was decided at all.
cards.translation: 會議徹底失敗，因為完全沒有作出任何決定。

cards.note: recall + N / that 子句；與 remind（提醒）區分。
cards.example: I can still recall my first crash-and-burn moment in school.
cards.translation: 我仍記得在學校第一次徹底失敗的時刻。

cards.note: give / make a presentation；present v. 提交／呈現；the presenter 報告者（補充）。
cards.example: Each student must give a presentation on one movie at the end of the semester.
cards.translation: 每位學生都必須在學期末報告一部電影。

cards.note: 老師手寫補充：present 亦可作 adj.「現在的」、n.「禮物」；注意重音與詞性。
cards.example: Hannah is going to present her report to her professor tomorrow.
cards.translation: 漢娜明天要向教授提交報告。

cards.note: skip–skipped–skipped；skip class 逃課；skip to 跳至；skip over 略過。
cards.example: I don’t usually skip class because I don’t like to fall behind my classmates.
cards.translation: 我通常不逃課，因為不想落後同學。

cards.note: v. ruin + 受詞；n. ruin / ruins；ruin the presentation；fall into ruin 陷入毀壞。
cards.example: Of course, I ruined the presentation and felt embarrassed in front of my classmates and teacher.
cards.translation: 當然，我搞砸報告，在同學和老師面前感到尷尬。

cards.note: 人感到 embarrassed；事情令人尷尬用 embarrassing；embarrass v.；embarrassment n.。
cards.example: Amy was really embarrassed about her mistake during the dance class, though nobody noticed it.
cards.translation: 舞蹈課出了錯，艾咪很尷尬，雖然沒有人注意到。

cards.note: 人感到 depressed；事情令人沮喪用 depressing；depress v.；depression n.。
cards.example: Emilia felt deeply depressed after her smartphone was stolen.
cards.translation: 手機被偷後，艾蜜莉亞感到非常沮喪。

cards.note: upset–upset–upset；動詞 upset sb；形容詞 be upset about + N / V-ing。老師圈出 about。
cards.example: Kyle was deeply upset about not winning first place in the swimming race.
cards.translation: 凱爾因為沒有在游泳比賽拿第一名而非常難過。

cards.note: reflect on + N / V-ing 認真思考；reflect an image 映出影像；reflection n.。
cards.example: The failure really upset me, but I reflected on it and learned from my mistake.
cards.translation: 這次失敗讓我很難過，但我仔細反省並從錯誤中學習。

cards.note: remind sb to V；remind sb of sth；remind sb that + 子句。
cards.example: Ms. Chen reminded her students of the importance of checking their homework.
cards.translation: 陳老師提醒學生檢查作業的重要性。

cards.note: 美式 realize；英式 realise；realize + that 子句；realize a dream 實現夢想。
cards.example: Matt suddenly realized that the time on his watch was wrong and that he was late for the meeting.
cards.translation: 馬特突然發現手錶時間不對，而且自己開會遲到了。

cards.note: tradition n. 傳統；traditionally adv. 傳統地；traditional Korean clothes 傳統韓服。
cards.example: Bella lived in Mexico for several years and can cook several traditional Mexican dishes.
cards.translation: 貝拉在墨西哥住過幾年，會做幾道傳統墨西哥料理。

cards.note: fortunate adj. 幸運的；fortunately = luckily；unfortunately 不幸地。
cards.example: My Korean was poor, but fortunately, everyone was very friendly.
cards.translation: 我的韓語不好，但幸好大家都很友善。

cards.note: the rest 作主詞時，動詞依所指名詞單複數而定。
cards.example: Daryl took a few bites of the cake and then gave the rest of it to his little sister.
cards.translation: 達瑞咬了幾口蛋糕，接著把剩下的給妹妹。

cards.note: = physically present；與 online 線上相對。
cards.example: Online lessons were fun sometimes, but I still found that I enjoyed seeing others in person more.
cards.translation: 線上課有時很有趣，但我還是覺得親自見到別人更開心。

cards.note: take the task seriously；serious adj. 嚴肅的；seriously adv. 認真地。
cards.example: Archie loves making fun of people, so don’t take his words seriously.
cards.translation: 阿奇喜歡開別人玩笑，所以別把他的話當真。

cards.note: let–let–let；let your team down；failure 課文情境。
cards.example: Roy promised his daughter that he would attend her school play, and he didn’t let her down.
cards.translation: 洛伊答應女兒會去看她的校園演出，沒有讓她失望。

cards.note: make sure (that) + 子句；make sure to V。
cards.example: Please make sure that you don’t go over the speed limit when you are driving.
cards.translation: 開車時請確保沒有超速。

cards.note: put–put–put；put your team first；first 此處為副詞。
cards.example: Most parents put their children’s needs first and want them to be happy and healthy.
cards.translation: 大多數父母把孩子的需求放第一，希望他們快樂健康。

cards.note: dress up as + 角色；dress up in + 衣服。
cards.example: Every Halloween, the young cousins dress up as their favorite cartoon characters.
cards.translation: 每年萬聖節，年幼的表親都裝扮成最喜歡的卡通人物。

cards.note: go / travel abroad；不是 go to abroad。
cards.example: My first trip abroad—to Seoul, South Korea—was unforgettable.
cards.translation: 我第一次出國旅行到南韓首爾，令人難忘。

cards.note: prepare v. 準備；prepared adj. 有準備的；un- 表否定。
cards.example: When the time came for me to step onto the stage, I was nervous and unprepared.
cards.translation: 輪到我上台時，我既緊張又沒有準備好。

cards.note: be nervous about / before；nervously adv. 緊張地。
cards.example: When the time came for me to step onto the stage, I was nervous and unprepared.
cards.translation: 輪到我上台時，我既緊張又沒有準備好。

cards.note: be friendly to / with sb；字尾 -ly 不代表它一定是副詞。
cards.example: My Korean was poor, but fortunately, everyone was very friendly.
cards.translation: 我的韓語不好，但幸好大家都很友善。

cards.note: memory 複數 memories；make / have memories。
cards.example: At the end of the trip, I left with a lot of great memories, and I can’t wait to go back someday!
cards.translation: 旅程結束時，我帶著許多美好回憶離開，迫不及待有一天再回去！

cards.note: 美式 pajamas；英式 pyjamas。
cards.example: I never thought that I could take classes in my pajamas!
cards.translation: 我從沒想過竟能穿著睡衣上課！

cards.meaning: Kahoot 線上互動學習平台
cards.note: 課文提及的線上課程工具。
cards.example: I also enjoyed using online tools such as Kahoot! and Quizlet.
cards.translation: 我也喜歡使用 Kahoot! 和 Quizlet 等線上工具。

cards.meaning: Quizlet 單字卡學習應用程式
cards.note: Words for Recognition 認讀字；可用閃卡學習。
cards.example: I also enjoyed using online tools such as Kahoot! and Quizlet.
cards.translation: 我也喜歡使用 Kahoot! 和 Quizlet 等線上工具。

cards.note: funny filter 趣味濾鏡；filter 也可作動詞「過濾」。
cards.example: Another time, our teacher accidentally turned on a funny filter on her camera.
cards.translation: 另一次，老師不小心開啟了相機上的趣味濾鏡。

cards.note: look like an alien 看起來像外星人。
cards.example: She looked like an alien on the screen, so my classmates and I had another good laugh.
cards.translation: 她在螢幕上看起來像外星人，於是我和同學又笑了一場。

cards.note: 課文用作形容詞，修飾 moment；可拆為 crash and burn 理解畫面。
cards.example: I can still recall my first crash-and-burn moment in school.
cards.translation: 我仍記得在學校第一次徹底失敗的時刻。

cards.note: South Korea 南韓首都。
